principle_violations.reason: The Order class is responsible for both order management (items, quantities, prices) and its state (status). Also, the PaymentProcessor class has a method that modifies the order state.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the order handling and payment processing into dedicated classes. The Order class should focus solely on managing order details and the PaymentProcessor should manage payment transactions.
